release.name: Spotlight
release.author: Izumi
release.description: Modelled on the HiAnime site: indigo surfaces with a pale pink accent and a top bar. Home opens on a numbered "Spotlight" banner with pill buttons and no slide markers, then sharp-cornered poster rows; the Trending row stamps a large rank number on each cover. The watch page docks a wide player with the episode list beside it; the series page is a full-bleed overlay with a large pink Watch button and a snapshot episode grid. Phones use a flush bottom bar with pink active tabs.
